meta.title: DSH-Mobile
meta.description: Pair a phone browser with this Desktop instance: shared Web UI, streaming output, and tool-call approvals (once / always / reject).

pair.title: Pair phone · DSH Mobile Bridge
pair.hint: Scan the QR code on the desktop, or open this URL and enter the code.
pair.name: Device name (optional)
pair.noCode: No active pairing code on the desktop. On the computer, open Settings → Mobile Bridge → "New pairing code", then come back here.
pair.mismatch: The code does not match. Check the 6-digit code on the desktop screen and try again.
pair.tooMany: Too many wrong attempts for this code. It is now void — generate a new one on the desktop.
pair.busy: The pairing confirmation channel is busy. Try again shortly.
pair.limit: Device limit reached ({max}). Revoke an old device on the desktop first.

wait.title: Waiting for desktop approval · DSH Mobile Bridge
wait.p: Code verified. Approve this pairing in the DSH window on your computer — this page continues automatically.
wait.limit: Device limit reached. Revoke an old device on the desktop first.
wait.expired: Approval timed out. Refresh the pairing page on the desktop and retry.
